Michelle D: Quick ping on PR #948 — small rename + lint fixes needed before merge. CI is green except pre-commit failed on a couple of files. Can someone take a quick look at the naming nit? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/948

Lint Bot: pre-commit failure: 
- trailing-whitespace in src/runtime/kvcache.rs
- flake8: F401 unused import in tests/test_batching.py
Run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally or fix in a follow-up commit.

Alex K: I skimmed — main issue is the `ctx_id` identifier. Suggest renaming to `context_id` for clarity.
Quick one-liner I used to update locally: `git grep -l "ctx_id" | xargs sed -i '' -e 's/ctx_id/context_id/g'` (mac sed; on Linux drop the '' arg).
Also update the docstring in `server/handler.rs` to match.

Ryan T: thanks Alex. Michelle — if you push the rename and fix pre-commit, I can re-run CI and approve. Note I try to hold merges to the 3pm PT merge window unless it's tiny and low-risk. This should qualify but ping me when green.

Michelle D: Will push in a few mins. Running `pre-commit run --all-files` now.

[bot] Lint Bot: running pre-commit...
[bot] Lint Bot: all hooks passed ✅

Michelle D: Pushed commit 3f8a2b2 with rename + whitespace fixes. Also updated the test import. Short changelog line added.
Diff snippet:
```
- let ctx_id = cache.lookup(key);
+ let context_id = cache.lookup(key);
```

Alex K: Quick local look: whitespace and naming changes are fine. One tiny suggestion: keep `context_id` in snake_case in Rust modules but ensure JS layer still uses `contextId` if that's the public contract. Otherwise 👍 — approved from me. :thumbsup:

Ryan T: I re-ran CI on the updated branch, all green. Approved. I'll merge during the 3pm PT slot unless Michelle asks for immediate merge.

Michelle D: Thanks both. No rush, merge during window is fine. If any fallout I'll revert.

Deploy Bot: staging deploy queue empty; next deploy window 15:00 PT.

Michelle D: Marking this thread resolved — thanks for the quick reviews!
